# Casper JS SDK

> TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for the Casper Network

## Docs

- [CasperNetwork](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/CasperNetwork): A high-level, version-aware client that auto-detects whether the node is Casper 1.x or 2.0 and dispatches transactions in the correct format automatically.
- [makeAuctionManagerDeploy](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeAuctionManagerDeploy): Creates a legacy `Deploy` for auction (staking) operations: delegate, undelegate, or redelegate.
- [makeAuctionManagerTransaction](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeAuctionManagerTransaction): Creates a `Transaction` for auction (staking) operations. Uses native builders for Casper 2.0 nodes and wraps a legacy `Deploy` for 1.x nodes.
- [makeCep18TransferDeploy](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeCep18TransferDeploy): Creates a legacy `Deploy` for transferring CEP-18 (ERC-20 compatible) fungible tokens. For Casper 2.0 nodes use [`makeCep18TransferTransaction`](/utilities/makeCep18TransferTransaction).
- [makeCep18TransferTransaction](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeCep18TransferTransaction): Creates a `Transaction` for transferring CEP-18 (ERC-20 compatible) fungible tokens. Supports both Casper 1.x (wraps a Deploy) and Casper 2.0 (uses `ContractCallBuilder`).
- [makeCsprTransferDeploy](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeCsprTransferDeploy): Creates a legacy `Deploy` for a native CSPR transfer (Casper 1.x format).
- [makeCsprTransferTransaction](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeCsprTransferTransaction): Creates a `Transaction` for a native CSPR transfer. Uses `NativeTransferBuilder` for Casper 2.0 nodes and wraps a legacy `Deploy` for 1.x nodes.
- [makeNftTransferDeploy](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeNftTransferDeploy): Creates a legacy `Deploy` for transferring an NFT. Supports CEP-47, CEP-78, and CEP-95 standards.
- [makeNftTransferTransaction](/casper-js-sdk/utilities/makeNftTransferTransaction): Creates a `Transaction` for transferring an NFT. Supports CEP-47, CEP-78, and CEP-95 standards. Works with both Casper 1.x (wraps a Deploy) and Casper 2.0.
- [Account](/casper-js-sdk/types/account): Represents an on-chain account with associated keys, action thresholds, and a main purse.
- [AddressableEntity](/casper-js-sdk/types/addressable-entity): Represents an addressable entity in Casper 2.x - a unified concept encompassing accounts, smart contracts, and system entities.
- [Args](/casper-js-sdk/types/args): Named argument map used to pass parameters to contract entry points and deploy sessions.
- [AuctionState](/casper-js-sdk/types/auction-state): Represents the current state of the Casper auction system, including all active bids and era validator weights.
- [BidKind](/casper-js-sdk/types/bid-kind): A polymorphic container for all bid variants in the Casper 2.x auction system.
- [Bid](/casper-js-sdk/types/bid): Bid-related types for validators, delegators, and unbonding operations.
- [BlockProposer](/casper-js-sdk/types/block-proposer): Represents the entity that proposed a block. Can be the system itself or a validator identified by public key.
- [Block](/casper-js-sdk/types/block): Block structure with header, body, transactions, and finality proofs. Supports both Casper 1.x and 2.x formats.
- [ByteCode](/casper-js-sdk/types/byte-code): Represents system bytecode stored on-chain, identified by a kind tag and raw bytes.
- [ByteConverters](/casper-js-sdk/types/byte-converters): Low-level utility functions for serializing numbers and data structures to and from byte arrays in little-endian format.
- [ContractPackage](/casper-js-sdk/types/contract-package): Tracks all versions of a deployed contract, including access control groups and disabled versions.
- [ContractWasm](/casper-js-sdk/types/contract-wasm): A container for the raw WASM bytecode of a deployed contract.
- [Contract](/casper-js-sdk/types/contract): Represents a smart contract stored on-chain, including its entry points, named keys, and package/wasm hashes.
- [Conversions](/casper-js-sdk/types/conversions): Utility class for encoding/decoding between Base16, Base64, and hex, plus CSPR ↔ motes conversion.
- [DeployInfo](/casper-js-sdk/types/deploy-info): Information about an executed deploy, including gas used, the initiating account, and associated transfers.
- [Deploy](/casper-js-sdk/types/deploy): The legacy transaction format used in Casper 1.x. A deploy contains a header, a payment item, a session item, and approvals.
- [EntryPoint](/casper-js-sdk/types/entry-point): Entry point definitions for smart contracts - access controls, argument types, return types, and payment options.
- [EraEnd](/casper-js-sdk/types/era-end): Data attached to a **switch block** - the last finalized block of an era - marking the end of that era. Contains equivocators, inactive validators, seigniorage rewards, and the validator weights for the next era. Only present on switch blocks; `block.eraEnd` is `null` for all other blocks.
- [EraInfo](/casper-js-sdk/types/era-info): Contains seigniorage allocation information for an era - how rewards were distributed among validators and delegators.
- [EraSummary](/casper-js-sdk/types/era-summary): Summary of an era retrieved from the blockchain, including a merkle proof for verification.
- [ExecutableDeployItem](/casper-js-sdk/types/executable-deploy-item): The polymorphic item type used for the `payment` and `session` fields of a Casper 1.x `Deploy`.
- [ExecutionResult](/casper-js-sdk/types/execution-result): The outcome of executing a deploy or transaction, including gas consumed, error messages, transfers, and state effects.
- [HexBytes](/casper-js-sdk/types/hex-bytes): A byte array wrapper with convenient hex string conversion methods.
- [InitiatorAddr](/casper-js-sdk/types/initiator-addr): Identifies the initiator of a transaction - either by public key or account hash.
- [MinimalBlockInfo](/casper-js-sdk/types/minimal-block-info): Lightweight block summary containing only the most commonly needed fields.
- [NamedKey](/casper-js-sdk/types/named-key): Named keys allow accounts and contracts to store human-readable labels for global state keys.
- [PricingMode](/casper-js-sdk/types/pricing-mode): Specifies how a transaction's execution cost is calculated and paid. Casper 2.x supports three pricing modes.
- [StoredValue](/casper-js-sdk/types/stored-value): A discriminated union representing any value that can be stored in global state. The active field indicates which type is present.
- [Time](/casper-js-sdk/types/time): `Timestamp` and `Duration` types for handling block and transaction timing.
- [TransactionEntryPoint](/casper-js-sdk/types/transaction-entry-point): Specifies which entry point a transaction targets - built-in system entry points or a custom contract entry point.
- [TransactionScheduling](/casper-js-sdk/types/transaction-scheduling): Controls when a transaction executes - immediately, at a future era, or at a future timestamp.
- [TransactionTarget](/casper-js-sdk/types/transaction-target): Specifies where a transaction executes - natively on the platform, in a stored contract, or via an inline WASM session.
- [TransactionV1Payload](/casper-js-sdk/types/transaction-v1-payload): The payload of a Casper 2.x `TransactionV1`, containing all fields needed to build, sign, and submit a transaction.
- [Transaction](/casper-js-sdk/types/transaction): The unified transaction type supporting both Casper 1.x `Deploy` and 2.x `TransactionV1` formats.
- [Transfer](/casper-js-sdk/types/transfer): Represents a token transfer, supporting both Casper 1.x and 2.x formats.
- [Transform](/casper-js-sdk/types/transform): Represents a state transformation - a change to a specific key in global state as a result of transaction execution.
- [UnbondingPurse](/casper-js-sdk/types/unbonding-purse): Represents a pending unbonding (unstaking) request for a validator or delegator.
- [BlockAdded](/casper-js-sdk/sse/block-added): Fires when a new block is finalized and added to the chain.
- [DeployProcessed](/casper-js-sdk/sse/deploy-processed): Fires when a legacy Deploy (Casper 1.x format) completes execution.
- [Fault](/casper-js-sdk/sse/fault): Fires when a validator equivocates (signs two conflicting blocks in the same slot).
- [FinalitySignature](/casper-js-sdk/sse/finality-signature): Fires when a validator submits a finality signature for a block. A block achieves strict finality once validators controlling more than two-thirds of total stake weight have submitted signatures - at that point the block is irreversible.
- [SSE Events](/casper-js-sdk/sse/introduction): The Casper node exposes a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream on port 9999 for real-time blockchain events.
- [Step](/casper-js-sdk/sse/step): Fires at the end of each era when the auction step executes, distributing rewards and updating validator weights.
- [TransactionAccepted](/casper-js-sdk/sse/transaction-accepted): Fires when a transaction is accepted into the node's mempool (before execution).
- [TransactionExpired](/casper-js-sdk/sse/transaction-expired): Fires when a transaction's time-to-live (TTL) expires before it was processed.
- [TransactionProcessed](/casper-js-sdk/sse/transaction-processed): Fires when a transaction finishes execution on the network. This is the primary event for monitoring transaction outcomes.
- [Account Response](/casper-js-sdk/responses/account): Raw response from `getAccountInfo` / `getLatestEntity`. Shows the structure of an account with named keys pointing to deployed contracts.
- [Auction Bid Response](/casper-js-sdk/responses/auction-bid): Raw bid structures from `getLatestAuctionInfo`. The format changed significantly between Casper 1.x and 2.x - both are shown here.
- [Block Response](/casper-js-sdk/responses/block): Raw response from `getBlockByHash` / `getLatestBlock` on a Casper 2.x node.
- [Deploy Result Response](/casper-js-sdk/responses/deploy): Raw response from `getDeploy` on a Casper 1.x node. Deploys are the legacy transaction format, still valid on 2.x nodes.
- [Blockchain Responses](/casper-js-sdk/responses/introduction): This section shows real RPC response payloads and how the SDK parses them into typed objects. All examples come directly from the SDK's test fixtures - real data from the Casper Network.
- [Node Status Response](/casper-js-sdk/responses/node-status): Raw response from `getStatus`. Useful for checking whether a node is synced, its current era/height, and connected peers.
- [Transaction Result Response](/casper-js-sdk/responses/transaction): Raw response from `getTransactionByTransactionHash` on a Casper 2.x node (V1-compatible format, wrapping a legacy Deploy).
- [Errors](/casper-js-sdk/glossary/errors): Reference for all error types and codes in the Casper JS SDK.
- [Terms](/casper-js-sdk/glossary/terms): Glossary of Casper Network and SDK terminology.
- [Types](/casper-js-sdk/glossary/types): Reference for key TypeScript types in the Casper JS SDK.
- [Error Handling](/casper-js-sdk/docs/error-handling): The SDK uses several error patterns depending on the layer.
- [FAQ](/casper-js-sdk/docs/faq): Casper has two transaction formats:
- [Getting Started](/casper-js-sdk/docs/getting-started): Get up and running with the Casper JS SDK in minutes.
- [Installation](/casper-js-sdk/docs/installation): For browser use without a bundler:
- [Why Casper JS SDK](/casper-js-sdk/docs/introduction): The Casper JS SDK is the official TypeScript/JavaScript library for building applications on the [Casper Network](https://casper.network). It provides a complete, type-safe interface for key management, transaction construction, node queries, and real-time event streaming.
- [Migration Guide (v2 → v5)](/casper-js-sdk/docs/migration-guide): This guide covers breaking changes when upgrading from casper-js-sdk v2 to v5.
- [TypeScript](/casper-js-sdk/docs/typescript): The Casper JS SDK is written in TypeScript and ships full type definitions.
- [Args](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/Args): A named container of CLValues, used as the runtime arguments for contract entry point calls.
- [CLValueParser](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/CLValueParser): Parses CLValues from JSON (RPC responses) or binary bytes.
- [Collection Types](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/collections): CLValue factories for List, Map, Option, Result, and Tuple types.
- [CLValues](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/introduction): CLValue (Contract Language Value) is the type system used for all data passed to and returned from Casper smart contracts.
- [CLValue.newCLValueBool](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/newCLBool): Creates a CLValue of type `Bool`.
- [CLValue.newCLByteArray](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/newCLByteArray): Creates a CLValue of type `ByteArray` from a `Uint8Array`.
- [CLValue.newCLKey](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/newCLKey): Creates a CLValue of type `Key` wrapping any Casper key variant.
- [CLValue.newCLPublicKey](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/newCLPublicKey): Creates a CLValue of type `PublicKey`.
- [CLValue.newCLString](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/newCLString): Creates a CLValue of type `String`.
- [CLValue.newCLUref](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/newCLUref): Creates a CLValue of type `URef` (Unforgeable Reference).
- [Numeric Types](/casper-js-sdk/clvalues/numeric): CLValue factories for all integer types.
- [Introduction to Clients & Transports](/casper-js-sdk/clients/intro): The Casper JS SDK uses a client-based architecture similar to viem. A **Client** groups related methods and is backed by a **Transport** that handles the actual network communication.
- [RpcClient](/casper-js-sdk/clients/rpc-client): The `RpcClient` is the primary interface for querying the Casper Network. It implements the full Casper JSON-RPC 2.0 API.
- [SpeculativeClient](/casper-js-sdk/clients/speculative): The `SpeculativeClient` allows dry-running transactions against the current chain state without submitting them on-chain.
- [SseClient](/casper-js-sdk/clients/sse-client): The `SseClient` connects to a Casper node's event stream (port 9999) and delivers real-time blockchain events.
- [HTTP Transport](/casper-js-sdk/clients/transports/http): `HttpHandler` is the HTTP transport for `RpcClient` and `SpeculativeClient`. It sends JSON-RPC 2.0 requests using axios.
- [ContractCallBuilder](/casper-js-sdk/builders/ContractCallBuilder): Builds a transaction that calls an entry point on a deployed smart contract.
- [NativeDelegateBuilder](/casper-js-sdk/builders/NativeDelegateBuilder): Builds a native delegate (stake) transaction to stake CSPR with a validator.
- [NativeRedelegateBuilder](/casper-js-sdk/builders/NativeRedelegateBuilder): Builds a native redelegate transaction to move stake from one validator to another without waiting for the unbonding period.
- [NativeTransferBuilder](/casper-js-sdk/builders/NativeTransferBuilder): Builds a native CSPR transfer transaction (TransactionV1 format).
- [NativeUndelegateBuilder](/casper-js-sdk/builders/NativeUndelegateBuilder): Builds a native undelegate transaction to unstake CSPR from a validator.
- [SessionBuilder](/casper-js-sdk/builders/SessionBuilder): Builds a transaction that deploys and executes WASM session code. Used for contract deployment and complex one-off operations.
- [Transaction Builders](/casper-js-sdk/builders/introduction): Transaction builders provide a fluent API for constructing `TransactionV1` (Casper 2.x) transactions.
- [getDeploy](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/getDeploy): Retrieves a legacy deploy by its hash.
- [getDeployFinalizedApproval](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/getDeployFinalizedApproval): Retrieves a deploy along with its finalized approvals - the set of approvals used during execution, which may differ from the approvals originally submitted.
- [getTransactionByDeployHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/getTransactionByDeployHash): Retrieves a transaction by its legacy deploy hash, returning it in the unified `Transaction` wrapper.
- [getTransactionByTransactionHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/getTransactionByTransactionHash): Retrieves a transaction by its TransactionV1 hash.
- [getTransactionFinalizedApprovalByDeployHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/getTransactionFinalizedApprovalByDeployHash): Retrieves a transaction along with its finalized approvals using a legacy deploy hash - the approvals used during execution, which may differ from those originally submitted.
- [getTransactionFinalizedApprovalByTransactionHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/getTransactionFinalizedApprovalByTransactionHash): Retrieves a transaction along with its finalized approvals using a V1 transaction hash - the approvals used during execution, which may differ from those originally submitted.
- [putDeploy](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/putDeploy): Submits a signed legacy `Deploy` object to the network.
- [putTransaction](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/putTransaction): Submits a signed `Transaction` (TransactionV1 or Deploy wrapper) to the network.
- [waitForDeploy](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/waitForDeploy): Polls the node until a legacy deploy is confirmed on-chain (i.e., has an execution result), or throws if the timeout is reached.
- [waitForTransaction](/casper-js-sdk/actions/transactions/waitForTransaction): Polls the node until a `TransactionV1` is finalized, then returns the result.
- [getDictionaryItem](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/getDictionaryItem): Reads a single entry from a contract dictionary by its URef seed and key.
- [getDictionaryItemByIdentifier](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/getDictionaryItemByIdentifier): Retrieves a dictionary item using a custom `ParamDictionaryIdentifier`, enabling lookups by contract name, account, or URef.
- [getStateRootHashByHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/getStateRootHashByHash): Returns the state root hash for a specific block, identified by its block hash.
- [getStateRootHashByHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/getStateRootHashByHeight): Returns the state root hash for a specific block height.
- [getStateRootHashLatest](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/getStateRootHashLatest): Returns the state root hash of the latest block. Used as a consistent snapshot reference for state queries.
- [queryGlobalStateByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/queryGlobalStateByBlockHash): Queries a value from global state at a specific block, identified by hash.
- [queryGlobalStateByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/queryGlobalStateByBlockHeight): Queries a value from global state at a specific block height.
- [queryGlobalStateByStateHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/queryGlobalStateByStateHash): Queries a value from global state at a specific state root hash.
- [queryLatestGlobalState](/casper-js-sdk/actions/state/queryLatestGlobalState): Queries a value from global state at the latest block.
- [getChainspec](/casper-js-sdk/actions/node/getChainspec): Returns the chain specification of the connected network.
- [getPeers](/casper-js-sdk/actions/node/getPeers): Returns the list of peers connected to the node.
- [getStatus](/casper-js-sdk/actions/node/getStatus): Returns the current status and metadata of the connected node.
- [getBlockByHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/block/getBlockByHash): Returns a block by its hex hash string.
- [getBlockByHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/block/getBlockByHeight): Returns a block at a specific height.
- [getBlockTransfersByHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/block/getBlockTransfersByHash): Returns the transfers included in a specific block, identified by hash.
- [getBlockTransfersByHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/block/getBlockTransfersByHeight): Returns the transfers included in a specific block, identified by height.
- [getLatestBlock](/casper-js-sdk/actions/block/getLatestBlock): Returns the most recent block on the chain.
- [getLatestBlockTransfers](/casper-js-sdk/actions/block/getLatestBlockTransfers): Returns the transfers included in the most recent block.
- [getLatestBalance](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/getLatestBalance): Returns the balance of a purse by URef at the latest state. This is the legacy balance API for Casper 1.x.
- [queryBalanceByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryBalanceByBlockHash): Returns the CSPR balance at a specific block, identified by hash.
- [queryBalanceByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryBalanceByBlockHeight): Returns the CSPR balance at a specific block height.
- [queryBalanceByStateRootHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryBalanceByStateRootHash): Returns the CSPR balance of an account or purse at a specific state root hash.
- [queryBalanceDetailsByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryBalanceDetailsByBlockHash): Returns detailed CSPR balance information at a specific block, identified by hash.
- [queryBalanceDetailsByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryBalanceDetailsByBlockHeight): Returns detailed CSPR balance information at a specific block height, including locked amounts and vesting schedules.
- [queryBalanceDetailsByStateRootHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryBalanceDetailsByStateRootHash): Returns detailed CSPR balance information at a specific state root hash, including locked amounts and vesting schedules.
- [queryLatestBalance](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryLatestBalance): Returns the CSPR balance of an account or purse at the latest block.
- [queryLatestBalanceDetails](/casper-js-sdk/actions/balance/queryLatestBalanceDetails): Returns the CSPR balance of an account including a breakdown of holds (locked amounts).
- [getAuctionInfoByHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getAuctionInfoByHash): Returns the auction state at a specific block, identified by block hash. Automatically handles both Casper 1.x (V1) and Casper 2.x (V2) node responses.
- [getAuctionInfoByHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getAuctionInfoByHeight): Returns the auction state at a specific block height. Automatically handles both Casper 1.x (V1) and Casper 2.x (V2) node responses.
- [getDelegatorRewardByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getDelegatorRewardByBlockHash): Returns the reward earned by a delegator for a specific validator at the era corresponding to a specific block hash.
- [getDelegatorRewardByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getDelegatorRewardByBlockHeight): Returns the reward earned by a delegator for a specific validator at the era corresponding to a specific block height.
- [getDelegatorRewardByEraID](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getDelegatorRewardByEraID): Returns the reward earned by a delegator for a specific validator in a specific era.
- [getEraInfoByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getEraInfoByBlockHash): Returns the era info at a specific block, identified by block hash.
- [getEraInfoByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getEraInfoByBlockHeight): Returns the era info at a specific block height.
- [getEraInfoLatest](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getEraInfoLatest): Returns the era info for the most recent block, including switch block transfers.
- [getEraSummaryByHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getEraSummaryByHash): Returns the era summary for a specific block, identified by block hash.
- [getEraSummaryByHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getEraSummaryByHeight): Returns the era summary at a specific block height.
- [getEraSummaryLatest](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getEraSummaryLatest): Returns a summary of the current era, including era ID and validator weights.
- [getLatestAuctionInfo](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getLatestAuctionInfo): Returns the current auction state including all validator bids and delegations.
- [getLatestDelegatorReward](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getLatestDelegatorReward): Returns the reward earned by a delegator in the most recent completed era.
- [getLatestValidatorReward](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getLatestValidatorReward): Returns the reward earned by a validator in the most recent completed era.
- [getValidatorChangesInfo](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getValidatorChangesInfo): Returns a list of validators whose status changed in the most recent era.
- [getValidatorRewardByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getValidatorRewardByBlockHash): Returns the reward earned by a validator at the era corresponding to a specific block hash.
- [getValidatorRewardByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getValidatorRewardByBlockHeight): Returns the reward earned by a validator at the era corresponding to a specific block height.
- [getValidatorRewardByEraID](/casper-js-sdk/actions/auction/getValidatorRewardByEraID): Returns the reward earned by a validator in a specific era.
- [getAccountInfo](/casper-js-sdk/actions/account/getAccountInfo): Returns account information for an account identifier, optionally scoped to a specific block (Casper 1.x format).
- [getAccountInfoByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/account/getAccountInfoByBlockHash): Returns account information for a public key at a specific block, identified by block hash.
- [getAccountInfoByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/account/getAccountInfoByBlockHeight): Returns account information for a public key at a specific block height.
- [getEntityByBlockHash](/casper-js-sdk/actions/account/getEntityByBlockHash): Returns an addressable entity (account or smart contract) at a specific block, identified by block hash. This is the Casper 2.x equivalent of `getAccountInfo`.
- [getEntityByBlockHeight](/casper-js-sdk/actions/account/getEntityByBlockHeight): Returns an addressable entity (account or smart contract) at a specific block height. This is the Casper 2.x equivalent of `getAccountInfo`.
- [getLatestEntity](/casper-js-sdk/actions/account/getLatestEntity): Returns the addressable entity for an account or contract (Casper 2.x format).
- [PrivateKey](/casper-js-sdk/accounts/private-key): Represents a cryptographic private key for signing transactions and messages.
- [PublicKey](/casper-js-sdk/accounts/public-key): Represents a cryptographic public key. Used for account identification, signature verification, and deriving account hashes.
